title: Dynamic Magic Link URLs (Local vs Production)
description: Magic links should use localhost:3001 when requested from local dev, and production URL when requested from production. Currently SITE_URL is hardcoded in Convex env vars.

technicalContext.problem: SITE_URL env var is single value - can't be both localhost and production
technicalContext.solution: Use request origin header to determine base URL dynamically, or remove baseURL and let Better Auth infer from trustedOrigins

acceptanceCriteria.text: Research Better Auth docs for dynamic baseURL or origin-based URL construction
Modify convex/betterAuth.ts to construct magic link URL based on request origin
If origin is localhost:3001, magic link should use http://localhost:3001
If origin is production, magic link should use production URL
Test locally: send magic link, verify email contains localhost:3001 URL
Test production: send magic link, verify email contains production URL

implementationNotes: Implemented in feature/auth-fixes worktree. Added rewriteMagicLinkUrl() helper that extracts origin from authCtx.headers and rewrites the URL to match the requesting origin. Uses TRUSTED_ORIGINS array for security.
